name: Mapo Tofu
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 small piece of ginger, minced (about 2 tsp)
200 g (7 oz) minced beef, or pork
1 tbsp Szechuan pepper, roasted and ground
3–4 green onions, cut into 2 cm (1 inch) pieces

steps: If using dried mushrooms, soak them in hot water for 10 minutes while preparing the rest of the ingredients, then slice before adding later.
Sauté onion with ginger and crushed chili.
Add minced meat and garlic, and fry until brown.
Mix in other ingredients (including sliced mushrooms), lower heat, and simmer for 5–10 minutes.

culture.text: Mapo tofu is a popular Chinese dish from Sichuan province. It consists of tofu set in a spicy sauce, typically a thin, oily, and bright red suspension, based on douban, and douchi, along with minced meat, traditionally beef. Variations exist with other ingredients such as water chestnuts, onions, other vegetables, or wood ear fungus. It is likely to have originated at a Chengdu restaurant in the 1860s–1870s.
